nodes.name: Orphan/coherence logic in orphan.rs lacks defensive handling for malformed auto traits and continues into panic path
orphan_check_impl always invokes lint_auto_trait_impl for auto traits after do_orphan_check_impl, even when earlier validation errors exist
lint_auto_trait_impl contains unchecked assert on trait_ref.args.len(), so malformed generic auto traits panic instead of being rejected gracefully
